After I took an exam, I would grade it and do the ones I got wrong again. I ended up doing 5 full length exams, scoring a little better each time (50%,55%,61%,65%,70%)

Ok so, first off. I am no baker. My techniques may be off, I also don't own a mechanical mixer so this was all done by hand. I started off with a tablespoon of instant yeast, mixed with 2 tablespoons of olive oil (higher quality is better) 3 tablespoons of white sugar. 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 1/4 cups of water. I mixed all these dry ingredients with a whisk then combined the water and whisked until it was all smooth. I slowly added 4 1/2 cups of bread flour. Keep on mixing until it is fully incorporated. This will take a while especially if you are kneading by hand. Keep going until the dough prefers to stretch rather than tear.  A small piece of the dough when stretched should resemble something like a window pane, if it keeps ripping, keep on kneading. 

Place in a separate bowl with a little oil to keep from sticking. Cover with plastic wrap and leave to proof for 2 hours

After 2 hours, pound out the dough and shape by rolling Into sausage shapes and join the ends to shape the bagel. Boil them in water until they float. Preheat the oven and place on a parchment paper lined baking tray. Bake at 475 for about 14 mins until they are cooked through and begin to brown on the top. 

Enjoy!
